warrior.name: Shield Bash
warrior.desc: 1.6× damage and a 2s stun on the enemy in front of you.

fx._js: c => { const m = c.tgt; if (!m || m.dead || Math.hypot(m.x - P.x, m.y - P.y) - m.d.r > 90) { say('Shield Bash missed. Get closer.', 'warn'); return; } hitMob(m, bdm(1.6), '#ffd08a'); if (!m.dead) stunMob(m, 2); fxShock(m.x, m.y); shake(0.15); }

warrior.name: Rend
warrior.desc: Slash open the enemy in front: 1.2× damage and it bleeds for 6 seconds.

fx._js: c => { fxSlash(); const m = c.tgt; if (m && !m.dead && Math.hypot(m.x - P.x, m.y - P.y) - m.d.r < 100) { hitMob(m, bdm(1.2), '#ff5a6a'); if (!m.dead) { m.burn = 6; m.burnTick = 1; } burst(m.x, m.y, 1, 'blood', 8, 1.2); } }

warrior.name: Leap Slam
warrior.desc: Leap onto an enemy up to 380 away: 1.8× damage around the landing and a short stun.

fx._js: c => { const m = c.tgt, a = Math.atan2(m.y - P.y, m.x - P.x), dd = m.d.r + P.r + 8; P.x = m.x - Math.cos(a) * dd; P.y = m.y - Math.sin(a) * dd; pushOut(P); if (P.x > 10000) constrain(P, P.x, P.y); fxShock(P.x, P.y); ringFx(P.x, P.y, 120, 0xff7a3a, 0.4); shake(0.3); Sound.play('boom'); aoeHit(P.x, P.y, 120, 1.8, { stun: 1 }); }
